title: The operator's place detail names accounts through the host instead of reading the account table, and Tracy finds a principal by email whatever its case
steps: S1: On the open package's schema (no account table) a principal saved a place twice; placeDetail is called with and without the host's emailOf and displayNameOf.
S2: Tracy's host is asked principalOf with the email in another case, and emailOf for an account and for an unknown id.
S3: The /ops/wo place detail door is read on Tracy.
expect: S1: with them the account row has the email, name and 2 opportunities; without them email and name are null; no error.
S2: the same principal is found; emailOf answers the email, null for the unknown id.
S3: the detail names every account by email as before.
evidence: Before: placeDetail joined Tracy's account table, failing on the open schema; principalOf compared the email case-sensitively
fence: placeDetail groups wo_opportunity by account_id and names each through emailOf/displayNameOf; principalOf compares lower(email)

tests: the place detail names its accounts through the host
Tracy's principal is found whatever the case of the email
Tracy's host names a principal's email
the detail names every account by email
